replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has caller-supplied merchantId and multi-merchant partners; concrete cross-merchant billing attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"API key is the only stated credential; leaked-key abuse is a concrete attack on this feature."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Billable-on-create endpoint; bulk creation inflating merchant cost is concrete and distinct from T2."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Declared value is client-supplied and billing is automatic; tampering attack supported."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Third-party-raised charges with multi-partner merchants; attribution gap concretely harms dispute resolution."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Caller-supplied merchantId enables enumeration via differing responses; distinct harm (relationship data disclosure)."}]}
